steps.content: [Blank Screen]

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: Now that I think of it, I have already pictured meeting him in reality many times...
steps.female_content: Now that I think of it, I have already pictured meeting her in reality many times...

steps.content: It's either the journalist Apple Juice interviewing the Gray Mirror star Exterminator... or a celebration after Apple Juice has teamed up with her internet friend to tackle Hot Toddy...

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: But this... is surely beyond my imagination!
[First Encounter CG]
The Corruptor has been eliminated. Contact the Public Security Bureau to check for any injured civilians in the vicinity.

It's a new type of Mania capable of traveling in and out of mobile phones without leaving physical contamination. It moved too fast for me to get a more detailed analysis. No wonder the Eastside M-value network didn't react.
The nature of the incident has changed. Cover up the news for now to avoid public panic. The MBCC will take over the investigation of this case to find the instigator...
Wow, am I in some kind of romance drama? Who is he talking to through the earpiece? Probably a sheriff. Right, he's an investigator, after all.
steps.female_content: Wow, am I in some kind of romance drama? Who is she talking to through the earpiece? Probably a sheriff. Right, she's an investigator, after all.

steps.content: And everything matches the description in the post too. Gray hair, gray uniform, appearing at every Mania incident.
But I'm sure it wasn't his doing. I just know. I could tell he was a good person the first time I saw him.
steps.female_content: But I'm sure it wasn't her doing. I just know. I could tell she was a good person the first time I saw her.

steps.content: The eyewitness is fine. She claimed in the video that she's a journalist from DisTV News. Yes, she's the one actively providing assistance.
Yes, I know, I haven't let my guard down. Please investigate her background, and the rest... I'll handle it on-site.
He mentioned me! But why does he seem less lively in real life? Oh, he must be the kind of people who take their work very seriously... That only adds to the charm. It's getting more interesting.
steps.female_content: She mentioned me! But why does she seem less lively in real life? Oh, she must be the kind of people who take their work very seriously... That only adds to the charm. It's getting more interesting.

steps.content: You mentioned in the video you sent me that your name is Bianca, right? To facilitate the investigation, can you answer some questions?
Did he just call my name? Oh right, I still don't know what his name is.
steps.female_content: Did she just call my name? Oh right, I still don't know what her name is.

steps.content: Bianca?
[Switch back to Chief's perspective]

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Bianca? Are you okay?
The girl who's covered in fruit patterns from head to toe stares blankly at you, unresponsive despite being called several times.
She may have been petrified by the monster. You try calling out to her again.

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: Ahh, yes! I, I, I am Bianca! Am I okay?... I'm okay!

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Yes, you're okay now.
She hesitates briefly before taking in the fact. She pulls out her press pass clumsily, her gaze unabashedly scanning you up and down.

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: You saved me! So, are you... Ashy? The one that got framed for being the mastermind behind the disappearances but who is in fact a special investigator from the Public Security Bureau?

You accept the nickname imperturbably and extend a graceful hand to Bianca, who shakes it vigorously with joy. The first formal greeting between two internet friends. Meanwhile, you urgently need to verify a few doubts in your mind...

That nickname sounds particularly embarrassing face-to-face. You force a smile and extend your hand to Bianca, who eagerly shakes it. The first formal greeting between two internet friends. Meanwhile, you urgently need to verify a few doubts in your mind...
[Shackles Effect]
The shackles silently encircle her exposed right hand. Although the girl behaves recklessly and has an obviously different understanding of Mania, which sets off alarm bells in your mind...
But the shackles perceive nothing. Wrong guess. She is indeed not a Sinner, just an ordinary person that has nothing to do with Mania.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: <color=#7683a2><size=32>If she indeed was the mastermind, things would actually be simpler...</size></color>

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: It's nothing. You said you're a journalist, right? Thank you for all the information you've provided so far. The Mania didn't hurt you, did it?
You withdraw the shackles discreetly, but she's still gripping your hand so tightly you fail to pull away. Bianca's eyes sparkle as she shakes your hand energetically.

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: You are even cooler than I imagined! You know, I've been making waves on the internet for so long, but you're the first one ever who gets a lead and immediately goes to confront the situation in reality! You're fearless! You're like the superhero of any superhero movie! Is this the uniform of the Public Security Bureau? I don't think I've seen it before...

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: Right! Where's that Simon? He even dared to put me, the justice seeker, up on Gray Mirror. I need to teach him a lesson.
She seems utterly unconcerned about the danger Mania may pose to the general public and keeps sharing her feelings and peeking behind you excitedly.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Simon didn't come with me. I handed him over to the Public Security Bureau before I rushed here. The sheriffs will give him the lesson he deserves. Your situation here was more urgent.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: This is a brand new form of Mania, and it got run into by someone reckless like you on its first appearance. I had to come here first. But thanks to you, I got to witness the full execution process of a user being purged, as Simon described.

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: Don't mention it, it was nothing... Wait, lesson? All he's getting is just a lesson? After what he did to you, you're letting him off the hook just like that?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: The disappearance cases were confirmed to be caused by Mania, so the suspicion around me has been cleared. As for Simon...
You look at the overly excited Bianca, deliberating over your word choice.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: His M-value is completely normal. He's had no contact with Mania, and he barely knows anything about Gray Mirror. Simon's actions are not legally culpable. Besides, it's not my job to deal with him anyway. Ordinary citizens are the Public Security Bureau's responsibility.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Anyway, thanks for your help along the way, Applehead. You've done more than enough. From here on, it's murky waters. Let the Public Security Bureau handle it. You should head back now.

You reiterate your advice to the ordinary citizen before you, but Bianca suddenly flings off your hand she's been holding with a loud snap. She smiles broadly, but her previous enthusiasm has quickly cooled down.

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: Alright, I get it, I'm all too familiar with that spiel! You just happened to get dragged into that vote and spooked out by those tales about the man-eating app. Now that you've cleared your name, won the vote, and got rid of the monster, you'll get your promotion and pay raise even if the case remains unresolved. I get it, I'm useless now. I'll see myself off then!

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: Who cares about Gray Mirror? Who cares about all that malice on that app? What do those victims have to do with you anyway? How much are justice and truth worth? The silly Applehead will leave you alone now. I won't bother the great investigator with this dead-end case anymore. Goodbye!
Bianca shakes her hands, turns around, and storms off, still rubbing her hands as if disgusted by that handshake with you.

steps.speaker: Bianca
steps.content: Tsk... In the end, I can only rely on myself. I must have been high on apple juice to expect anything from you...

Watching her leave in a huff, you don't try to stop her, but instead take out your phone and text your colleagues to protect the witness discreetly. Ordinary people should stay away from these kinds of things. For now, you have more important matters to attend to...

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: It's time to re-examine the scene of the Purge.

You look around. The Mania has disappeared completely, leaving no further clues at the scene. Next, should you return to the Public Security Bureau to continue interrogating Simon? Probably nothing will come out of that.

Simon is not the mastermind. His M-value is normal, and he hasn't got what it takes to be the owner of Gray Mirror. Judging from his personality, he was simply manipulated by the real culprit, and there must be many more like him on Gray Mirror.

Amid the ongoing voting frenzy on Gray Mirror, people have quickly lost interest in you. You're safe now. No one will curse you anymore, nor will monsters emerge from your phone to attack you.
